raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously treated Warner Bros. Nashville as an imprint under Warner Bros. Entertainment (implying ownership by Warner Bros. Discovery), instead of recognizing it as part of Warner Music Group, which is majority controlled by Access Industries (Len Blavatnik). This conflation of the film/TV company with the music group could lead to the wrong ownership answer.
